source_documents.title: Tetraphenylbenzene Based AIE Luminogen with Donor-Acceptor Structure: Unique Mechanochromic Emission and High Exciton Utilization

reference_evidence_units.quote: Molecular structure and synthesis routes of PXZ-TPB-CN.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PXZ-TPB-CN (provisional source designation for pending-name case)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: PXZ-TPB-CN at 10 micromolar in THF/water (300 nm excitation), pristine/ground/fumed powders, vacuum-evaporated film and non-doped OLED.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Scheme 1 names the paper's single newly studied AIE emitter PXZ-TPB-CN; this is the provisional source designation for case 0096.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The manifest's name is pending reconciliation. Source selection and the sole studied emitter support a provisional designation only; no candidate-graph matching was performed.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This phenomenon is readily ascribed to the effect of twisted intermolecular charge transfer (TICT).
reference_evidence_units.subject: PXZ-TPB-CN (provisional source designation for pending-name case)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: PXZ-TPB-CN at 10 micromolar in THF/water (300 nm excitation), pristine/ground/fumed powders, vacuum-evaporated film and non-doped OLED.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Initial water addition up to 60% causes red shift and quenching, which the authors assign to TICT.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The accepted manuscript literally says 'intermolecular'; retain its wording rather than silently correcting it to intramolecular. No twisted-state geometry is directly established.

reference_evidence_units.quote: activation of restriction of intramolecular motion, demonstrating an AEE feature
reference_evidence_units.subject: PXZ-TPB-CN (provisional source designation for pending-name case)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: PXZ-TPB-CN at 10 micromolar in THF/water (300 nm excitation), pristine/ground/fumed powders, vacuum-evaporated film and non-doped OLED.
reference_evidence_units.statement: At higher water fractions aggregation produces stronger, blue-shifted PL, assigned partly to motion restriction and reduced polarity effects.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The mechanism is an author interpretation from solvent/aggregation trends, not direct internal-motion measurement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The F in THF solution was measured to be 2.2%, whereas, the value in the solid state was recorded to be 5.9%.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PXZ-TPB-CN (provisional source designation for pending-name case)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: PXZ-TPB-CN at 10 micromolar in THF/water (300 nm excitation), pristine/ground/fumed powders, vacuum-evaporated film and non-doped OLED.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Solution and pristine solid quantum yields are 2.2% and 5.9%.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Main Figure 1 inspected; these are not ground-powder or evaporated-film values.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the ground sample emits a bright bluish green light at 484 nm.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PXZ-TPB-CN (provisional source designation for pending-name case)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: PXZ-TPB-CN at 10 micromolar in THF/water (300 nm excitation), pristine/ground/fumed powders, vacuum-evaporated film and non-doped OLED.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Grinding shifts pristine 460 nm emission to 484 nm and increases yield to 12.4%; DCM fuming restores approximately 458 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Figure 2 inspected. Reversibility concerns color/profile; full yield recovery was not independently established.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the sharp diffraction peaks after grinding partly disappeared
reference_evidence_units.subject: PXZ-TPB-CN (provisional source designation for pending-name case)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: PXZ-TPB-CN at 10 micromolar in THF/water (300 nm excitation), pristine/ground/fumed powders, vacuum-evaporated film and non-doped OLED.
reference_evidence_units.statement: PXRD and a ground-sample 139 C cold-crystallization feature support crystalline-to-partly-amorphous conversion.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Figure 3 inspected; loss of some peaks does not justify saying every ground molecule is amorphous.

reference_evidence_units.quote: multiple weak intermolecular interactions could partially restrict the intramolecular motion of molecules in the aggregate state
reference_evidence_units.subject: PXZ-TPB-CN (provisional source designation for pending-name case)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: PXZ-TPB-CN at 10 micromolar in THF/water (300 nm excitation), pristine/ground/fumed powders, vacuum-evaporated film and non-doped OLED.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Crystal contacts are proposed to constrain motions; the source reports almost no adjacent pi stacking.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a packing-enabled RIM proposal, not an aggregate-exciton or excimer assignment.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the energy gap between T5 and S1 is as low as 0.043 eV
reference_evidence_units.subject: PXZ-TPB-CN (provisional source designation for pending-name case)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: PXZ-TPB-CN at 10 micromolar in THF/water (300 nm excitation), pristine/ground/fumed powders, vacuum-evaporated film and non-doped OLED.
reference_evidence_units.statement: DFT reported in main text places T5 only 0.043 eV above S1; 77 K spectra give S1/T1 2.63/2.33 eV. Authors propose T5-to-S1 hRISC rather than conventional T1-to-S1 TADF.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Underlying SI calculations/spectra were not inspected. An energy gap alone is not a measured hRISC rate.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the experiment EQE value is much higher than the theoretical EQE value
reference_evidence_units.subject: PXZ-TPB-CN (provisional source designation for pending-name case)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: PXZ-TPB-CN at 10 micromolar in THF/water (300 nm excitation), pristine/ground/fumed powders, vacuum-evaporated film and non-doped OLED.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Measured maximum OLED EQE 2.9% exceeds the source's 1.6% fluorescent estimate, supporting proposed triplet utilization; the estimate includes 79% horizontal dipoles and 33% outcoupling.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Model-dependent inference with ideal charge recombination; not direct time-resolved proof of T5 transfer. Higher-triplet-to-S1 transfer is not anti-Kasha emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: suggesting that it doesn’t possess traditional TADF feature.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PXZ-TPB-CN (provisional source designation for pending-name case)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: PXZ-TPB-CN at 10 micromolar in THF/water (300 nm excitation), pristine/ground/fumed powders, vacuum-evaporated film and non-doped OLED.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Pristine powder shows only prompt 12.69 ns PL; the authors explicitly reject traditional TADF for this state.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Ground powder/film have longer 18.63/25.13 ns decays and an extra component; do not collapse all states into a conventional TADF label.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Proposed motion restriction explains AEE, bounded to the provisionally identified source compound.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Crystal contacts and reversible morphology change explain the mechanical luminescence response.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Retain the author's TICT interpretation with the accepted-manuscript terminology error and indirect evidence explicit.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: State-dependent decay components and inferred triplet-to-singlet exciton utilization are part of the source explanation; this overlaps with hRISC.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Preserve the explicit but tentative high-triplet RISC interpretation for ground/film/device states, not conventional TADF or a measured triplet transfer rate.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Proposed motion restriction explains AEE, bounded to the provisionally identified source compound.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Crystal contacts and reversible morphology change explain the mechanical luminescence response.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest binding, pore uptake or host inclusion mechanism is established; a solvent or self-assembly is not automatically host-guest chemistry.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Retain the author's TICT interpretation with the accepted-manuscript terminology error and indirect evidence explicit.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific excited-state proton-transfer pathway is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on is established; energy transfer and CT character are not by themselves PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton or excimer mechanism is established; aggregation alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: State-dependent decay components and inferred triplet-to-singlet exciton utilization are part of the source explanation; this overlaps with hRISC.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Preserve the explicit but tentative high-triplet RISC interpretation for ground/film/device states, not conventional TADF or a measured triplet transfer rate.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection mechanism is established; rotation restriction alone does not prove CI access.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: T5-to-S1 RISC still ends in S1 emission; this does not establish higher-singlet emission or anti-Kasha behavior.
